proposed.text: What is the source-backed MDPE multiplier range per SPP 202 Sec 5.2?
proposed.rationale: SPP Document 202, Section 5.2 states that the MDPE multiplier ranges from 1.5 to 2.5, depending on office setup, overhead, the Architect's experience, and project complexity. The article body explicitly warns not to treat 2.8, 3.0, or 3.5 as source-backed MDPE multipliers; 2.7-3.2 is an exam trap. Source: PRBoA SPP 202 Sec 5.2 (https://www.architectureboard.com.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/1.4-2010-SPP-for-PH-Architects.pdf).
proposed.explanation: SPP Document 202, Section 5.2 states that the MDPE multiplier ranges from 1.5 to 2.5. Higher 'practice ranges' such as 2.7-3.2 are not supported by the checked SPP 202 source.
